outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Columbia County's tax base shrunk between 2024, 2025 as new levies begin" (Erick Bengel, 2025-04-16)
notes: The pool district's excess levy, passed in November 2024, added 20.6 cents per $1,000 to 2025 tax bills; county assessed value fell 4.46% to $996 million after the Columbia Pulp closure.
